business_analyst.title: business analyst
business_analyst.description: Business analysts research and understand the strategic position of businesses and companies in relation to their markets and their stakeholders. They analyse and present their views on how the company, from many perspectives, can improve its strategic position and internal corporate structure. They assess needs for change, communication methods, technology, IT tools, new standards and certifications.

ict_business_analyst.title: ICT business analyst
ict_business_analyst.description: ICT business analysts are in charge of analysing and designing an organisation's processes and systems, assessing the business model and its integration with technology. They also identify change needs, assess the impact of the change, capture and document requirements and then ensure that these requirements are delivered whilst supporting the business through the implementation process.

data_analyst.title: data analyst
data_analyst.description: Data analysts import, inspect, clean, transform, validate, model, or interpret collections of data with regard to the business goals of the company. They ensure that the data sources and repositories provide consistent and reliable data. Data analysts use different algorithms and IT tools as demanded by the situation and the current data. They might prepare reports in the form of visualisations such as graphs, charts, and dashboards.

http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/79e29b8.title: collect ICT data
http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/79e29b8.description: Gather data by designing and applying search and sampling methods.
broader: gathering information from physical or electronic sources

http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/382c11e.title: apply statistical analysis techniques
http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/382c11e.description: Use models (descriptive or inferential statistics) and techniques (data mining or machine learning) for statistical analysis and ICT tools to analyse data, uncover correlations and forecast trends.
broader: analysing and evaluating information and data

http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/07889c0.title: normalise data
http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/07889c0.description: Reduce data to their accurate core form (normal forms) in order to achieve such results as minimisation of dependency, elimination of redundancy, increase of consistency.

http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/a56dec3.title: information confidentiality
http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/a56dec3.description: The mechanisms and regulations which allow for selective access control and guarantee that only authorised parties (people, processes, systems and devices) have access to data, the way to comply with confidential information and the risks of non-compliance.
broader: database and network design and administration

http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/9cf681c.title: query languages
http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/9cf681c.description: The field of standardised computer languages for retrieval of information from a database and of documents containing the needed information.
broader: software and applications development and analysis

http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/47a49cd.title: analyse big data
http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/47a49cd.description: Collect and evaluate numerical data in large quantities, especially for the purpose of identifying patterns between the data.
broader: evaluate data, information and digital content

http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/2daec0e.title: establish data processes
http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/2daec0e.description: Use ICT tools to apply mathematical, algorithmic or other data manipulation processes in order to create information.

http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/9920770.title: resource description framework query language
http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/9920770.description: The query languages such as SPARQL which are used to retrieve and manipulate data stored in Resource Description Framework format (RDF).
broader: software and applications development and analysis

http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/03ff0d5.title: information structure
http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/03ff0d5.description: The type of infrastructure which defines the format of data: semi-structured, unstructured and structured.
broader: database and network design and administration

http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/cc7370d.title: data quality assessment
http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/cc7370d.description: The process of revealing data issues using ​quality indicators, measures and metrics in order to plan data cleansing and data enrichment strategies according to data quality criteria.

http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/c3e36d0.title: deliver visual presentation of data
http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/c3e36d0.description: Create visual representations of data such as charts or diagrams for easier understanding.

http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/43ae58b.title: database

http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/1b7c716.title: MDX

broader: software and applications development and analysis

http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/f597f77.title: N1QL
http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/f597f77.description: The computer language N1QL is a query language for retrieval of information from a database and of documents containing the needed information. It is developed by the software company Couchbase.
broader: software and applications development and analysis

http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/a80fb09.title: manage data collection systems
http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/a80fb09.description: Develop and manage methods and strategies used to maximise data quality and statistical efficiency in the collection of data, in order to ensure the gathered data are optimised for further processing.

http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/a57a54b.title: LDAP
http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/a57a54b.description: The computer language LDAP is a query language for retrieval of information from a database and of documents containing the needed information.

http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/1605025.title: web analytics
http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/1605025.description: The characteristics, tools and techniques for measurement, collection, analysis and reporting of web data to get information on the users' behaviour and to improve the performance of a website.

http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/c7d2459.title: LINQ
http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/c7d2459.description: The computer language LINQ is a query language for retrieval of information from a database and of documents containing the needed information. It is developed by the software company Microsoft.
broader: software and applications development and analysis

http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/3f4dab5.title: XQuery
http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/3f4dab5.description: The computer language XQuery is a query language for retrieval of information from a database and of documents containing the needed information. It is developed by the international standards organisation World Wide Web Consortium.
broader: software and applications development and analysis

http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/a7f0fbe.title: data storage
http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/a7f0fbe.description: The physical and technical concepts of how digital data storage is organised in specific schemes both locally, such as hard-drives and random-access memories (RAM) and remotely, via network, internet or cloud.

http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/5da8018.title: SPARQL

broader: software and applications development and analysis

http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/0c766ca.title: gather data for forensic purposes

http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/fbafa41.title: create data models
http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/fbafa41.description: Use specific techniques and methodologies to analyse the data requirements of an organisation's business processes in order to create models for these data, such as conceptual, logical and physical models. These models have a specific structure and format.

http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/b0a3bb2.title: online analytical processing
http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/b0a3bb2.description: The online tools which analyse, aggregate and present multi-dimensional data enabling users to interactively and selectively extract and view data from specific points of view.
broader: database and network design and administration
